home.headline: SIMPLE
home.briefP1: SIMPLE is UNFPA's integrated SRHR data visualisation and programme intelligence platform, designed to strengthen monitoring, programme learning, evidence generation, and evaluation data management. It consolidates field submissions from three implementing partners — Centre for Injury Prevention and Research, Bangladesh (CIPRB), Bandhu Social Welfare Society and Partners in Health and Development (PHD) — into one live dashboard.
home.briefP2: Final programme brief is confirmed at the validation workshop on 3–4 June 2026 — this text will be replaced after sign-off.
home.coverageSubtitle: Each colour shows where one or more partners operate. Click a district to jump to that partner's page. Overlap shading flags districts where two or three partners overlap.
home.rollupSubtitle: Sum of achievement against the sum of all set targets, across every indicator in that partner's SIDA framework.

fistulaViz.reachSub: Where the community campaign has actually run: activity days, households and population reached, by upazila.
fistulaViz.emptyReach: No fistula cases recorded yet — reach metrics will fill as patients are registered at the Suspected stage in CIPRB 1 — Fistula Question Bank.
fistulaViz.emptyFunnel: No fistula cases recorded yet — the patient pathway will fill as cases progress through CIPRB 1 — Fistula Question Bank.
fistulaViz.funnelSub: Number of patients at each stage of the care pathway: Suspected → Diagnosed → Referred for Surgical Management → Surgically Repaired → Rehabilitated & Reintegrated. Conversion percentages reflect retention between sequential clinical stages.
fistulaViz.pieSub: Of all women examined at the Fistula Corner, how the final diagnoses break down across the four fistula types.
fistulaViz.pieCaption: Cases classified by fistula type per the Fistula Question Bank — Obstetric, Iatrogenic, Congenital, Traumatic.
fistulaViz.pieEmpty: No Fistula Corner cases recorded yet — pie chart will fill as patients are examined and diagnoses recorded.
fistulaViz.typeSub: Of all diagnosed patients, how the anatomical fistula type breaks down. Recorded at the Fistula Corner when the diagnosis is made.
fistulaViz.typeEmpty: No fistula types recorded yet — this fills as patients are diagnosed and their type (VVF / RVF / …) is classified.

mpdsrViz.notifySub: Reporting Rate = notified vs estimated. Review Rate = reviewed vs notified. The gap shows what's still pending.
mpdsrViz.barEmpty: Bar chart fills as MPDSR cases are reported and reviewed.
mpdsrViz.perDistrictSub: Reported maternal deaths divided by the estimated denominator. Districts at the bottom need follow-up.
mpdsrViz.perDistrictEmpty: Per-district reporting rate will populate once denominators are loaded.
mpdsrViz.causeSub: Two charts side-by-side, split by source form. Left: community deaths (MPDSR Form 01). Right: facility deaths (MPDSR Form 04). Use the tabs to filter by district group.
mpdsrViz.causeFacilityTitle: Distribution of Causes of Maternal Deaths
mpdsrViz.groupEmpty: No maternal deaths recorded in this district group yet
mpdsrViz.groupEmptySub: Pie chart fills as cases come in from {{group}} districts. Switch to Cumulative to see all data combined.
mpdsrViz.causeEmpty: Breakdown fills as maternal death cases are recorded and the cause of death is assigned.
mpdsrViz.reviewExceedsNotified: More reviews than notifications. These deaths were reviewed but no notification slip was ever filed for them.
mpdsrViz.stillbirthRoute: Social Autopsy is the only review route for a stillbirth
mpdsrViz.responseSub: After each maternal death review, teams draft a response plan. This tracker compares planned interventions against what was genuinely carried out on the ground.
mpdsrViz.responseDataNoteBody: Showing baseline plan from Sayeed's MPDSR Action Plan summary. Field-form for executed-activity counts is pending — these numbers will update once Kobo capture is in place.
mpdsrViz.neoSub: Community (CIPRB 3) and facility (CIPRB 5) neonatal death reviews. Based on {{count}} neonatal deaths.
mpdsrViz.notifSlipSub: Field death-notification slips that trigger downstream review committee work. Based on {{count}} notifications.
mpdsrViz.saSub: Community re-review of each maternal death — the social and care-seeking circumstances behind it.
mpdsrViz.saCountSub: Maternal deaths re-reviewed through social autopsy.
mpdsrViz.saEmpty: No social autopsies recorded yet — submissions to CIPRB 6 will populate this.
mpdsrViz.saOtherKinds: {{other}} further social autopsies reviewed a neonatal death or a stillbirth ({{neonatal}} neonatal, {{stillbirth}} stillbirth) and are not counted in this maternal figure.
